questions.questionText: All of the occurrences listed below are examples of an insurable event as defined by the California Insurance Code EXCEPT

choices.text: a guest is injured by a fall from the insured's deck.

questions.sourceNotes: A state-lottery loss is speculative risk (a gamble), not a fortuitous insurable event - connects the Insurable Interest and Pure-vs-Speculative-Risk concepts.

questions.questionText: All of the following would be considered unfair trade practices EXCEPT

choices.text: making a statement misrepresenting terms of any policy issued.

questions.sourceNotes: Subtle: the CA Unfair Practices Act prohibits UNFAIR discrimination specifically, not all discrimination (legitimate risk-based classification is lawful) - the source marks choice 2 as the exception on that basis. Preserved as-is per source discipline; flagged for authoritative review given the subtlety (see verification queue).
